items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion example: a bordered, expandable FAQ list with item, trigger and animated content panel. Open items take a muted tint, and the caret flips between down and up as a panel expands.

items.name: activity-goal
items.title: Activity Goal
items.description: Daily goal tracker card for habit and productivity dashboards: a 13-day recharts bar chart of focus minutes against an adjustable target line, stepper buttons, a met count and a Set goal button that announces the saved value.

items.name: activity-goal-card
items.title: Activity Goal Card
items.description: Goal tracker card for fitness and habit dashboards: a large adjustable target with minus and plus buttons and a recharts bar chart where entries that meet the goal fill in the accent above a dashed line. Requires recharts 3.8.0.

items.name: activity-goal-card-volunteer-hours
items.title: Activity Goal Card Volunteer Hours
items.description: Example of the Activity Goal Card: a volunteer-hours target you can raise or lower, with a folded shift estimate beneath the chart. The card is a dashboard goal or activity tracker with a chart.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert example: an inline status callout with title, description and an optional top-right action. Default and destructive variants; a leading icon moves the text into a second column.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog example: a modal confirmation with blurred overlay, header, optional media circle, title, description and footer. Action and Cancel render as buttons, and a small size is available.

items.name: app-stats
items.title: Weekly Installs Card
items.description: KPI stats card for weekly installs and growth: a large total, a hairline recharts sparkline over eight weeks with only the latest point highlighted, and a change caption. Recharts is pinned to 3.8.0.

items.name: area-chart-01
items.title: Listeners Area Chart Card
items.description: Area chart card for analytics dashboards: a two-series time series of daily listeners, desktop solid and mobile dashed, with a select for 90, 30 or 7 days and a legend that draws the dash.

items.name: area-chart-02
items.title: Fine Listener Areas
items.description: Fine area chart for dashboards: daily listener areas with thin blue and dashed gray lines, light fills, a date range control and a ruled mono caption.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect ratio example: a plain wrapper that holds its children to a width-to-height ratio you set, for images, video and cards. No client JavaScript is needed.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Attachment example: a file chip with media, title, description and action slots, in three sizes and horizontal or vertical layout. Upload states show a dashed idle edge and a shimmering progress.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar example: a round user picture with image, fallback initials and a corner status badge, in small, default and large sizes. AvatarGroup overlaps faces with a ring and adds a remaining count.

items.name: avatar-moss-orb
items.title: Avatar Moss Orb
items.description: Avatar example: an avatar painted as the moss Cloudy Nimbus orb beside a name, decorative and hidden from assistive tech, with its ring off. Shows an orb as a generated profile picture.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge example: a small pill label in default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost and link variants. It can render as a link, for statuses, tags and counts.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct
items.description: Badge example in the Neoconstruct poster style: square, uppercase, with a heavy border in the theme's gold. Brings the Neoconstruct theme with it.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-ribbon
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Ribbon
items.description: Badge example: a poster-red Neoconstruct badge with a gold corner folded in. Shows a ribbon-style badge for sale or featured labels.

items.name: badge-neoconstruct-room-status
items.title: Badge Neoconstruct Room Status
items.description: Badge example: a Neoconstruct room list with status badges, one inverted for open, and a disclosure for each room. Shows badges as availability status labels.

items.name: bar-chart-01
items.title: Monthly Column Bar Chart
items.description: Vertical bar chart card for monthly stats: a column chart of sessions with the value printed above each rounded bar, and a footer with a trend sentence, icon and note.

items.name: bar-chart-02
items.title: Horizontal Ranking Bar Chart
items.description: Horizontal bar chart card for a leaderboard: five countries ranked by listeners, with country names on the axis and values printed at the end of each bar.

items.name: bar-chart-03
items.title: Diverging Bar Chart
items.description: Positive and negative bar chart card for weekly change: a diverging column chart of week-on-week variance by day, bars rising and falling from a zero line with signed percentage labels.

items.name: bar-chart-04
items.title: Fine Session Bars
items.description: Fine bar chart for dashboards: slim square-ended monthly session bars with the latest month in blue, a large current value and a ruled mono caption.

items.name: bar-chart-05
items.title: Fine Country Bars
items.description: Fine horizontal bar chart for dashboards: slim listener bars with country labels, exact values and a ruled October caption.

items.name: bar-chart-06
items.title: Fine Weekly Change
items.description: Fine positive and negative bar chart for dashboards: listening-time bars with a dashed zero line, signed tooltip values and a weekly summary.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb example: a navigation trail of list, item, link, current page, caret separator and ellipsis parts. The link part can be replaced by a framework router link.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat bubble component with group, content and reactions parts. Variants cover primary, secondary, muted, a primary-tinted fill, outline, ghost and destructive, for message threads and AI chat.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button example: default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive and link variants. Sizes run from extra small to large plus four square icon sizes, with focus ring and invalid states.

items.name: button-embossed
items.title: Button Embossed
items.description: Button example: embossed, the paper raised a hair with the ink as the label, on cream paper, and black paper in dark mode. A tactile button style.

items.name: button-frosted
items.title: Button Frosted
items.description: Button example: a frosted glass button over a rising Moon Sphere, with a see-through fill, a hairline and a soft inner glow, blurred over the light behind.

items.name: button-frosted-loading
items.title: Button Frosted Loading
items.description: Button example: a disabled frosted button with a spinner before its label, over a rising Moon Sphere. Shows the loading state of the glass button.

items.name: button-frosted-media-controls
items.title: Button Frosted Media Controls
items.description: Button example: frosted icon buttons as a previous, pause and next media control row, the middle one larger. Shows glass icon buttons for a player.

items.name: button-frosted-pair
items.title: Button Frosted Pair
items.description: Button example: a hero call to action over a rising Moon Sphere, with a solid button for the main action and a frosted one for the second.

items.name: button-frosted-sizes
items.title: Button Frosted Sizes
items.description: Button example: the frosted button in each size, extra small to large, each beside its matching square icon button, over light rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: button-frosted-with-icon
items.title: Button Frosted With Icon
items.description: Button example: a frosted button with a play icon before its label, over light rising from the bottom edge. Shows an icon with a glass button.

items.name: button-gradient-border
items.title: Button Gradient Border
items.description: Button example: a dark pill with a thin sky-blue edge that fades at both ends, made from two backgrounds on a transparent border. Classes only, no extra markup.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Button group example: joins buttons, inputs and select triggers into one segmented control by squaring inner corners and collapsing shared borders. Horizontal or vertical, with a text cell.

items.name: button-letterpress
items.title: Button Letterpress
items.description: Button example: letterpress, ink pressed into paper, a dark filled button on cream paper with silver ink on black paper in dark mode. A tactile button style.

items.name: button-link-hairline
items.title: Button Link Hairline
items.description: Button example: nav links styled as ghost buttons where on hover the icon turns sky and a fading hairline grows in under the link from the center. Classes only.

items.name: button-lit-border
items.title: Button Lit Border
items.description: Button example: a glass pill whose indigo-to-cyan edge fades in on hover, drawn by a pseudo-element layer. Classes only, no extra markup.

items.name: button-menu
items.title: Button Menu
items.description: Button example: an outline icon button whose three lines fold into an X while its menu is open, driven by aria-expanded. A hamburger menu toggle.

items.name: button-menu-museum-header
items.title: Button Menu Museum Header
items.description: Button example: a museum header with a square outline menu button that folds into an X and opens a visitor navigation panel. Shows a hamburger menu toggle in a site header.

items.name: button-neoconstruct
items.title: Button Neoconstruct
items.description: Button example in the Neoconstruct poster style: square, uppercase, a heavy border on poster red and a hard offset shadow it slides into when pressed. Brings the Neoconstruct theme with it.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar example: a date picker grid built on react-day-picker with button-styled navigation and single or range selection. Supports dropdown captions and week numbers.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card example: a rounded surface with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots. A small size tightens the spacing, and an image placed first bleeds to the card's rounded corners.

items.name: card-cascade-after-hours
items.title: Card Cascade After Hours
items.description: Card example: a compact dark listening card with warm cascading bands, copper ink and a ruled monospace footer. Shows the cascade lines texture on a music card.

items.name: card-cascade-cool
items.title: Card Cascade Cool
items.description: Card example: a dark card with bands of blue rising from the bottom edge under fine grain. Hover lifts it and draws a rose-amber rule on the top edge, honoring reduced motion.

items.name: card-cascade-warm
items.title: Card Cascade Warm
items.description: Card example: a dark card with bands of red to amber falling from the top edge under fine grain. Hover lifts it and draws a rose-amber rule on the bottom edge, honoring reduced motion.

items.name: card-paper
items.title: Card Paper
items.description: Card example: a cream paper card tipped in by hand, with a hairline edge, a soft cast shadow and square corners for an image, on a cream page. Black paper on a black page in dark mode.

items.name: card-stock-dispatch
items.title: Card Stock Dispatch
items.description: Card example: an ink-blue cardstock with a postal masthead and a tipped, tilted cream plate. Shows a stationery-style card.

items.name: card-stock-private-viewing
items.title: Card Stock Private Viewing
items.description: Card example: silver-on-black cardstock with a tipped-in black plate and a blind-pressed link. Shows an invitation-style card.

items.name: card-stock-trail-ledger
items.title: Card Stock Trail Ledger
items.description: Card example: a sage field-guide plate with a numbered, ruled itinerary. Shows a card-stock list for travel or trail notes.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel example: a slide carousel built on embla-carousel-react with content, item, previous and next parts. Horizontal or vertical axis, arrow-key navigation and plugin support.

items.name: cascade-lines
items.title: Cascade Lines
items.description: Cascading lines texture: seven uneven bands of color fading inward from any edge of a positioned container, in warm red-to-amber and cool blue finishes. Used by the cascade Card examples.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart example: a recharts 3.8.0 wrapper with a responsive container, config-driven light and dark series colors, and tooltip and legend content. For line, bar and area charts in dashboards.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox example: a filled primary checked state, check icon indicator and an enlarged invisible hit area. Includes focus ring, disabled and invalid styling for form fields.

items.name: cloudy-nimbus-moss
items.title: Cloudy Nimbus Moss
items.description: Moss cloud paint disc for larger placements such as heroes and cards: a pre-rendered cloud painting with grain overlaid above small sizes; smaller discs trade the grain for a fine inner rim.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible example: an unstyled expandable section with root, trigger and content panel parts. It adds only slot attributes, so the open and closed look is left to you.

items.name: color-field-skeleton
items.title: Color Field Skeleton
items.description: Loading skeleton placeholder: pulsing bars on a Rothko color field that wait in grisaille and glaze the palette color in when switched to colored. Adjust the line count; the pulse is opacity only.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Combobox example: a searchable select with an input group field, trigger and clear buttons, grouped list, empty state and check indicators. A chips mode adds removable chips for multiple selection.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette example: built on cmdk with a search input, filtered list, groups, items, shortcuts and separators. CommandDialog opens it inside a Dialog, like a quick-search menu.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Context menu example: a right-click menu with items, destructive variant, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, keyboard shortcuts and nested submenus.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date range picker card for booking and reporting filters: a labeled trigger opens a two-month range calendar in a popover, preset to a 20-day span built with date-fns.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Date range picker field: an outline button showing the formatted range opens a popover with a two-month range Calendar. Works controlled or uncontrolled and formats dates with date-fns.

items.name: dense-grain
items.title: Dense Grain
items.description: Dense grain texture: heavy black noise from two tiles with coprime sizes, overlaid so the repeat never shows. A printed, slightly heavy full-bleed overlay for a relative parent.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog example: a centered modal with blurred overlay, header, title, description and footer. A ghost close button sits in the top corner by default.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Direction example: re-exports the DirectionProvider and useDirection hook so a subtree can switch between left-to-right and right-to-left layout for RTL languages.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Drawer example: a swipeable panel that opens from any edge, with snap points, nested drawer stacking, an optional swipe handle and an overlay that fades with swipe progress. Suits mobile sheets.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu example: a button-triggered menu with items, destructive variant, checkbox and radio items, group labels, shortcuts and nested submenus.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty state example: a layout with header, media, title, description and content slots, centered inside a padded box. The media slot has a plain variant and an icon variant on a muted tile.

items.name: exercise-minutes
items.title: Exercise Minutes
items.description: Line chart card for fitness and workout tracking: this week's exercise minutes compared with the average by day, both in primary ink with the average at half strength.

items.name: exercise-minutes-02
items.title: Fine Exercise Lines
items.description: Fine line chart for fitness dashboards: blue exercise minutes against a dashed gray average, with a current value and labeled line keys.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field example: fieldset, legend, group, label, title, description, separator and error parts. Vertical, horizontal and container-responsive layouts for building accessible forms.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: File explorer tree view card showing a nested project folder structure with collapsible folders, rotating carets and the selected file's path in the header. Rows are ghost buttons with icons.

items.name: film-grain
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: Film grain texture: faint noise from a single turbulence SVG tile at overlay blend and low opacity, to keep a flat color field from looking digital. A full-bleed overlay inside a relative parent.

items.name: fine-grain
items.title: Fine Grain
items.description: Fine grain texture: one-octave noise painted on a small tile so it stays crisp on high-density screens instead of clumping. Overlay blend with adjustable opacity; the grain-fine utility ships with it.

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist
items.description: Geist variable sans-serif font for the default body and UI text. Components read it first in the sans font stack, so installing it sets the typeface for the whole project without listing it per item.

items.name: font-geist-mono
items.title: Geist Mono
items.description: Geist Mono monospace font for code and mono labels, used by items such as Eyebrow, Chart, Thermal Button and the chat pieces. Variable font, wired into the mono font stack.

font.family: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

items.name: font-hanken-grotesk
items.title: Hanken Grotesk
items.description: Hanken Grotesk variable sans-serif display font for headlines, used by Heading, Hero, Footer and Quote and by many blocks and components such as Magazine Cover.

font.family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: font-overpass
items.title: Overpass
items.description: Overpass variable sans-serif font in the highway signage style, for road sign and wayfinding graphics. It installs with those graphics and nowhere else. Used for transit and signage artwork.

items.name: font-unbounded
items.title: Unbounded
items.description: Unbounded variable wide display font after constructivist block lettering, used as the heading typeface of the Neoconstruct theme. Installs with anything that sets the neoconstruct theme.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: Grain texture overlay in four treatments: plain noise, paper and sandpaper at overlay blend, and square at soft-light. Intensity steps from fine to rich or takes an exact opacity.

items.name: grain-bakery-slip
items.title: Grain Bakery Slip
items.description: Grain example: a bakery pickup slip on rich paper grain with an itemised order, a dashed collection window and a counter note. Shows the grain overlay on a receipt-style card.

items.name: grain-kit
items.title: Grain Kit
items.description: Grain toolkit: baked noise tiles as data URIs, a Grain Layers overlay and a grain style helper. Pick a finish such as micro, gray, felt or soft film and scale its strength over any art.

items.name: grain-veil
items.title: Grain Veil
items.description: Grain veil texture: noise drawn by one live SVG turbulence filter across the whole box, so it never tiles. Separate light and dark opacities and a theme-following blend; also exports a dither filter for gradient banding.

items.name: gritty-grain
items.title: Gritty Grain
items.description: Gritty grain texture: coarse black noise like raw canvas, using the same paired tiles as Dense Grain at roughly double the opacity. A full-bleed overlay; the tile is exported for reuse.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Hover card example: a hover-triggered preview with a trigger and a positioned popover-styled panel. Placement defaults to below the trigger, centered, with a short zoom.

items.name: hover-edge
items.title: Hover Edge
items.description: Hover edge accent: a thin rose and amber line on any edge of a positioned parent, as used on cascade Card examples. It appears on parent hover or keyboard focus, can mark a selected item, and honors reduced motion.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input example: a single-line text field with a soft filled background, rounded pill shape and file-input styling. Includes focus ring, disabled and invalid states.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input group example: wraps an input or textarea with inline or block addons for icons, text, keyboard hints and small buttons. Clicking an addon focuses the input.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: One-time code input example: built on the input-otp package with grouped slots, a blinking fake caret and a dash separator. The active slot shows a focus ring, for verification codes.

items.name: install-command
items.title: Install Command
items.description: Copyable install command for docs and CLI: a prompt symbol, a monospace shell command and a copy to clipboard button in an input group. If copying fails it selects the text and shows a hint; add the dark class over art.

items.name: install-command-episode-upload
items.title: Install Command Episode Upload
items.description: Example of the Install Command: a long upload command that wraps, with file and episode details below.

items.name: install-switcher
items.title: Install Switcher
items.description: Package manager install command with a gliding segmented switch inside the pill: pick pnpm, npm, yarn or bun and the command rewrites, and the copy button copies the one showing. Add the dark class over art.

items.name: install-switcher-api-quickstart
items.title: Install Switcher Api Quickstart
items.description: Example of the Install Switcher: set to npm in a developer quickstart card with a requirements list.

items.name: issue-report-form
items.title: Issue Report Form
items.description: Issue report form card with area and severity selects, a subject input and a details textarea under monospace uppercase labels. Validates with react-hook-form and zod, sends FormData to a React action, then resets.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Item example: a flexible list row with media, content, title, description, actions, header and footer parts. Default, outline and muted variants in three densities; can render as a link.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key example: an inline key label in a small muted rounded box, plus a group wrapper for key combinations. Adapts its colors inside an input group or a tooltip.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Label example: a plain form label with small medium-weight text that dims when its peer control or parent field is disabled. A native label element.

items.name: line-chart-01
items.title: Labeled Line Chart Card
items.description: Line chart card for engagement analytics: a single-series time series of average session minutes by month, each point labeled with its value, and a footer note on the trend.

items.name: line-chart-02
items.title: Fine Session Line
items.description: Fine line chart for dashboards: a thin blue session-length line with a marked endpoint, current value and ruled mono caption.

items.name: loop-settings-form
items.title: Loop Settings Form
items.description: Loop settings form card for audio or video tools: loop in and out times typed as m:ss, a large computed loop length, and fade in and out times in a collapsible section. Controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Marker example: a small muted inline note line with icon and content slots. Variants add hairline rules on both sides of centered text or a bottom border; renders as any element.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Menubar example: a desktop-style bar that holds several menus in one bordered strip. Reuses Dropdown Menu for content, items, shortcuts and nested submenus.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat message component with group, avatar, content, header and footer parts. Aligns to the start or end and reverses for outgoing messages; pairs with Bubble for the message body in chat UIs.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Chat transcript scroller from @shadcn/react with provider, viewport, content and item parts. Keeps the view pinned while messages stream in and fades the bottom edge, for AI chat interfaces.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: KPI stat card for dashboards and analytics: a metric name, a large tabular value, an optional outline badge with a trend-up or trend-down icon and screen-reader label, and an optional description line.

items.name: metric-card-dispute-rate
items.title: Metric Card Dispute Rate
items.description: Example of the Metric Card: a falling dispute rate stat on a navy ground, with a note and two supporting figures. The metric card is a KPI stat tile for dashboards and analytics.

items.name: moon-sphere
items.title: Moon Sphere
items.description: Moon sphere graphic: a single-element sphere lit on one limb, a radial gradient from the lower-left corner running transparent out to a warm rim color on the far edge. Used for moonrise effects over dark grounds.

items.name: moon-sphere-amber-paper
items.title: Moon Sphere Amber Paper
items.description: Moonrise example showing MoonSphere: warm paper holds an amber sphere at a modest size, with a short caption row and one line of note text.

items.name: moon-sphere-blue
items.title: Moon Sphere Blue
items.description: Blue moon example showing MoonSphere with a blue rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-blue-frost
items.title: Moon Sphere Blue Frost
items.description: Frosted panel example showing a blue MoonSphere on a dark glass panel, with a small caption row above it and one line of text below.

items.name: moon-sphere-empty-state
items.title: Moon Sphere Empty State
items.description: 404 page empty state example with a Moon Sphere: a message and two links sit on the left while a full blue moon fills the right. Shows how the glowing orb works as artwork on a not found or error screen.

items.name: moon-sphere-green
items.title: Moon Sphere Green
items.description: Moon Sphere color example with a green rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-hue-slider
items.title: Moon Sphere Hue Slider
items.description: Interactive Moon Sphere example on midnight blue with a range slider that sweeps the rim color through the full hue circle. Shows how one color value recolors the glowing orb live.

items.name: moon-sphere-jade-rise
items.title: Moon Sphere Jade Rise
items.description: Call to action section example with a Moon Sphere: a centered invitation sits above a large jade moon rising from the bottom edge of a dark panel. A glowing orb horizon for landing page closing sections.

items.name: moon-sphere-pink
items.title: Moon Sphere Pink
items.description: Moon Sphere color example with a pink rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-red
items.title: Moon Sphere Red
items.description: Moon Sphere color example with a red rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-rim-palettes
items.title: Moon Sphere Rim Palettes
items.description: Interactive Moon Sphere example: a blue moon with six buttons that switch its rim color and a status line naming the current choice. A pattern for letting users pick an orb color or theme.

items.name: moon-sphere-rising
items.title: Moon Sphere Rising
items.description: Hero section example with a Moon Sphere: a dark band with a centered heading and a line of copy, and a large glowing moon rising from the bottom edge like a planet on the horizon.

items.name: moon-sphere-rose-feature
items.title: Moon Sphere Rose Feature
items.description: Feature section example on warm clay paper: a rose Moon Sphere sits beside a short invitation with one link and a save button. Shows the glowing orb working on a light surface.

items.name: moon-sphere-silver
items.title: Moon Sphere Silver
items.description: Moon Sphere color example with a silver rim on a dark ground.

items.name: moon-sphere-silver-crop
items.title: Moon Sphere Silver Crop
items.description: Cropped orb panel example: an oversized silver Moon Sphere pushed off the left edge of a midnight blue panel so only its lit limb shows. A bold crescent backdrop for banners and hero sections.

items.name: moon-sphere-split
items.title: Moon Sphere Split
items.description: Quote section example with a Moon Sphere: a dark band with a testimonial and byline on the right and a glowing moon cropped by the left edge. On phones the moon steps aside to keep the quote readable.

items.name: moon-sphere-two-scales
items.title: Moon Sphere Two Scales
items.description: Orb size comparison example: two Moon Spheres on a plum ground, a small violet one and a larger silver one, each with a short caption. Shows how a single orb component scales for icons and hero art.

items.name: moon-sphere-violet
items.title: Moon Sphere Violet
items.description: Moon Sphere color example with a violet rim on a dark ground.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Native select example: a styled browser select element with a caret icon, small and default sizes, and option and optgroup parts. No custom popup, so platform pickers work.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Navigation menu example: a site menu with trigger, content, link and indicator parts. A shared popup resizes and slides between panels as the pointer moves across triggers.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination example: page navigation with previous, next, numbered links and an ellipsis. Links render as anchors styled like buttons; the active page takes the outline variant.

items.name: pie-chart-01
items.title: Donut Chart with Center Total
items.description: Donut chart card for a breakdown and distribution: minutes by genre with the total printed in the center, and a footer list giving each genre's swatch, minutes and share.

items.name: pie-chart-02
items.title: Fine Genre Ring
items.description: Fine donut chart for dashboards: a thin genre ring with blue and neutral segments, a center total and a complete text breakdown.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover example: a click-triggered floating panel with header, title and description parts. Positions below and centered on its trigger by default, with a short zoom and fade.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar example: a determinate bar with track, indicator, label and value parts. A label and value can sit above the bar.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questionnaire example: a step-by-step survey on the @shadcn/react questionnaire primitive with progress, choices, text input, errors and previous, skip, next and submit buttons.

items.name: radar-chart-01
items.title: Listening Moods Radar Chart
items.description: Radar spider chart card for scores and profiles: six listening moods rated out of 100, each axis label carrying its score so the values read without the shape.

items.name: radar-chart-02
items.title: Fine Listening Profile
items.description: Fine radar chart for dashboards: a thin blue listening-profile outline over a dashed polar grid, with labeled scores and a ruled caption.

items.name: radial-chart-01
items.title: Weekly Goal Radial Chart
items.description: Radial progress ring card for goal tracking: a narrow card showing progress toward a weekly listening goal, minutes in the center, the remaining track visible and a footer note.

items.name: radial-chart-02
items.title: Storage Capacity Gauge
items.description: Half-circle radial gauge for storage capacity on a dashboard, with used and available GB below it. Built on shadcn Card and Chart parts with a capacity-based axis on recharts 3.8.

items.name: radial-chart-03
items.title: Daily Target Rings
items.description: Three small radial progress rings for daily goals: focus hours, tasks and breaks. Each ring has a percentage, label and exact target, so progress reads without relying on color. Built on shadcn Card and Chart with recharts 3.8.

items.name: radial-chart-04
items.title: Sprint Progress Ring
items.description: Compact radial progress ring for sprint task completion, beside completed and remaining task counts. Built on shadcn Card and Chart parts, with the task total setting the full circle on recharts 3.8.

items.name: radial-chart-05
items.title: Budget Allocation Ring
items.description: Segmented radial chart for budget allocation: a full ring split into three stacked segments, with the total at its center and a text breakdown below.

items.name: radial-chart-06
items.title: Paper Storage Gauge
items.description: Half-circle storage gauge in warm paper and ink tones, framed by a paper mat with a dark finish, with used and available capacity in text below.

items.name: radial-chart-07
items.title: Dark Grain Sprint Ring
items.description: Sprint progress ring chart in bright blue on a dark navy card with grain texture, beside task counts.

items.name: radial-chart-08
items.title: Paper Grain Daily Targets
items.description: Three daily target progress rings on a fine paper-grain card, in light or dark mode, each with a label and exact target.

items.name: radial-chart-09
items.title: Fine Weekly Goal
items.description: Fine radial progress ring for dashboards: a thin blue weekly ring with listened minutes, a goal total and a ruled footer.

items.name: radial-chart-10
items.title: Fine Storage Gauge
items.description: Fine half-circle storage gauge for dashboards: a thin blue arc with a percentage and exact used and available capacity.

items.name: radial-chart-11
items.title: Fine Daily Targets
items.description: Fine radial progress rings for daily targets: three thin blue rings, each with its own label and exact value, over a ruled caption.

items.name: radial-chart-12
items.title: Fine Sprint Progress
items.description: Fine sprint progress ring for dashboards: a thin blue ring beside completed and remaining task counts, with mono labels and a ruled footer.

items.name: radial-chart-13
items.title: Fine Budget Ring
items.description: Fine segmented budget ring for dashboards: a thin ring in blue and neutral ink with a center total and a full text breakdown.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group example: circular items with a filled primary checked state and a centered dot indicator. Items get an enlarged hit area and focus, disabled and invalid styling.

items.name: report-issue
items.title: Report Issue
items.description: Bug report and support ticket form card: Area and Severity selects, a one-line subject and a details textarea, preset to Billing and Serious and ending in a Send report button.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panels example: split panes built on react-resizable-panels with group, panel and handle parts. Works horizontally or vertically, with an optional visible grip on the handle.

items.name: revenue-dashboard-01
items.title: Revenue Dashboard with Line Charts
items.description: Revenue dashboard with metric cards: a 30-day, 90-day or 12-month toggle and four cards, each with a total, change badge and recharts line chart with tooltip. Requires recharts 3.8.0.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll area example: a styled viewport with a thin rounded vertical scrollbar. Add the ScrollBar part with a horizontal orientation for sideways overflow.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Segmented control: a pill toggle group with a muted track where a lifted thumb glides to the pressed item, staying still under reduced motion. Horizontal only; values are arrays.

items.name: segmented-control-sleep-period
items.title: Segmented Control Sleep Period
items.description: Segmented Control example: a control in a dark card that swaps a week and month sleep summary. Shows a time range switcher for dashboards.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select example: a dropdown with trigger, value, grouped items, labels, separators and scroll arrows. The popup aligns the selected item over the trigger by default and marks it.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Separator example: a one-pixel divider line in the border color. Horizontal by default; the vertical orientation stretches to the height of its flex parent.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Audio editor settings card with m:ss time fields for loop in and loop out, plus fade in and fade out inputs in a collapsible advanced options section behind a show and hide toggle.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Sheet example: an edge panel that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left over a blurred overlay. Includes header, footer, title, description and a ghost close button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sidebar example: an app sidebar system with provider, menus, groups, sub-menus, rail and inset layout. Collapses offcanvas or to icons and writes open state to a cookie.

items.name: simple-footer-01
items.title: Muted Footer with Link Grid
items.description: Plain website footer on a muted band: up to five link categories in a grid that picks its own column count from how many there are, plus a copyright line. No dependencies.

items.name: simple-grain
items.title: Simple Grain
items.description: Simple grain overlay: a two-octave noise tile at overlay blend with adjustable opacity that follows the parent's corner radius. Built on the grain utility, which ships with the item.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton example: a loading placeholder, a rounded muted block with a pulse animation. Size and shape it with classes to stand in for text lines, avatars or cards while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider example: a range slider with a filled track and pill-shaped thumbs. Renders one thumb per array value, two when no array is given, in horizontal or vertical orientation.

items.name: slider-cloud-dancer
items.title: Slider Cloud Dancer
items.description: Slider example: the Cloud Dancer slider with a pale pill track, a dark bar for the filled range and a dark orb thumb, styled through the slider's slots.

items.name: slider-ticket-budget
items.title: Slider Ticket Budget
items.description: Slider example: a two-thumb Cloud Dancer slider that filters festival passes by price range. Shows a range slider for filtering.

items.name: soft-grain
items.title: Soft Grain
items.description: Soft grain texture: a five-octave fractal noise tile at overlay blend and very low opacity, giving a dark ground a gentle tooth. Three intensities from fine to rich.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading spinner example: spins the Phosphor spinner icon. It carries a status role and a Loading label so screen readers announce it, and sizes to a small default.

items.name: static-grain
items.title: Static Grain
items.description: Static grain texture: fine, even, neutral gray noise from its own paired tiles at low opacity so the repeat stays hidden. A full-bleed overlay inside a relative parent.

items.name: stats-card-01
items.title: Weekly Support KPI Card
items.description: Weekly metrics card: compact support stats with six figures in two columns, each with a change arrow and comparison text, kept level by a subgrid. Worsening changes show in red. A dashboard KPI card.

items.name: store-header-02
items.title: Minimal Store Header
items.description: Store header with centered mega menu: link-only columns, search and bag count, collapsing to a left Sheet with accordion categories on narrow screens. No announcement bar.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch example: an on/off toggle with a pill track and sliding thumb, in default and small sizes. Shows focus rings and invalid styling, and inverts its thumb colors in dark mode.

items.name: switch-appointment-reminder
items.title: Switch Appointment Reminder
items.description: Switch example: a Cloud Dancer switch on a pale green appointment card that chooses a text reminder and reports the current choice.

items.name: switch-cloud-dancer
items.title: Switch Cloud Dancer
items.description: Switch example: the Cloud Dancer switch with a pale pill track, teal-shaded and warming to rose when on, with a dark orb thumb, styled through the switch's slots.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table example: semantic table parts for header, body, footer, rows, cells and caption, wrapped in a horizontally scrolling container. Rows highlight on hover and in a selected state.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs example: tabbed panels with a pill-shaped default list, or a line variant that marks the active tab with a bar. Works horizontally or as a vertical side list.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea example: a multi-line text field on a soft filled ground that grows with its content. Includes focus rings, disabled styling and invalid-state borders.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast example: stacked notifications with a Toaster provider and a shared toast manager. Toasts peek behind each other, expand on hover and swipe to dismiss.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Toggle example: a two-state button that fills when pressed. Offers default and outline variants in small, default and large sizes, and the variants are exported for reuse.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle group example: a group of toggles that share variant and size. Set spacing to zero to join the items into one segmented control, laid out horizontally or vertically.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip example: a hover and focus hint with a provider, trigger and an inverted popup with an arrow. Positions to any side and animates in and out.

items.name: tooth-grain
items.title: Tooth Grain
items.description: Paper tooth grain texture: a single-octave noise tile at overlay blend, so a surface reads as fine paper without clumping into a pattern. Intensity steps or an exact opacity; full-bleed in a relative parent.

items.name: tooth-grain-collection-label
items.title: Tooth · Collection label
items.description: Tooth · Collection label: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-day-programme
items.title: Tooth · Day program
items.description: Tooth · Day program: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-edition-cover
items.title: Tooth · Edition cover
items.description: Tooth · Edition cover: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-field-note
items.title: Tooth · Field note
items.description: Tooth · Field note: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-order-receipt
items.title: Tooth · Order receipt
items.description: Tooth · Order receipt: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-quote-card
items.title: Tooth · Quote card
items.description: Tooth · Quote card: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-seasonal-menu
items.title: Tooth · Seasonal menu
items.description: Tooth · Seasonal menu: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-studio-card
items.title: Tooth · Studio card
items.description: Tooth · Studio card: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-studio-letter
items.title: Tooth · Studio letter
items.description: Tooth · Studio letter: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: tooth-grain-workshop-invitation
items.title: Tooth · Workshop invitation
items.description: Tooth · Workshop invitation: an example of tooth-grain.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Agent activity log: lines with an icon, title and timing, each marked running, error or pending. Running titles shimmer unless reduced motion is set, and steps expand for details. For AI agent tool-call traces.

items.name: traffic-overview
items.title: Traffic Overview
items.description: Website traffic analytics line chart card: views and unique readers over time, a date range select, a legend and a dot on the busiest day. The views color changes between light and dark. Uses recharts 3.8.

items.name: traffic-overview-02
items.title: Fine Traffic Lines
items.description: Fine website traffic line chart for dashboards: blue views and dashed gray reader lines, with a current value, date range control and ruled mono caption.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: Prose typography stylesheet from shadcn/typeset for rendered markdown, MDX, blog posts and documentation: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables and code inside a typeset container, with docs and editorial presets plus a serif reading preset.

items.name: use-cart
items.title: Use Cart
items.description: Shopping cart React hook for ecommerce: a client hook for cart state with lines, quantity clamping, remove, clear and reset, plus totals with pluggable shipping and tax estimates. Exports helpers for minor-unit money formatting.

items.name: use-chat-stream
items.title: Use Chat Stream
items.description: Chat streaming React hook: a client hook that posts a transcript to a chat endpoint and streams the reply over server-sent events. Accepts OpenAI or Anthropic shaped chunks; exposes send, stop, reset and load.

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: Use Copy To Clipboard
items.description: Copy to clipboard React hook: a client hook that writes text to the clipboard and reports copied for a set timeout, or failed until the next try. A late earlier write never overrides a newer one.

items.name: use-product-filters
items.title: Use Product Filters
items.description: Product filter React hook for faceted product lists: OR within a facet, AND across facets, price bands on number fields, sort options, results and a count of what each option would leave.

items.name: vibrant-grain
items.title: Vibrant Grain
items.description: Vibrant grain texture: sparkling noise in three stacked turbulence layers, the top one at screen blend so it reads as silver-halide glints rather than surface texture. One strength value scales every layer.
